llm.summary: This code-quality skill is mostly coherent, but it needs Review because it can publish repository findings externally and tells agents to keep running past normal stop controls.

dimensions.detail: The main refinement workflow is purpose-aligned for code quality analysis and optional fixes, but the insight-generation module adds GitHub Discussions posting of concrete findings, evidence, and recommendations, which is an external data flow beyond ordinary local refinement.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad triggers and ambiguous execution language: the table says default use is plan-only, while nearby text says execution does not stop at planning unless the user explicitly asks. It also includes instructions to continue after harness stop signals.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are markdown-only skill files with no packaged executable scripts. Metadata points to a Night Market source and optional plugin/config dependencies; static scan and VirusTotal telemetry are clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Repository reads, grep/find commands, and optional code edits are proportionate for a code-refinement skill, but GitHub publishing and path-specific execution under /home/alext/claude-night-market are not clearly scoped to the installing user's environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install persistent services, but it instructs agents to write synthesis documents and, in execution mode, record closure commits; more importantly, it tells agents to resume after stop signals until completion gates are met.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a code-review skill that may move from planning into edits when invoked with execution phrases. Disable or ignore the insight-generation module unless you explicitly want findings posted to GitHub Discussions, and require a preview/approval step before any external posting or broad refactoring run.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Applying code changes can fit a refinement workflow when the user asks to execute findings, but the artifact's execution wording is partly inconsistent and should be reviewed before enabling automatic edits.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The GitHub Discussions posting module is real artifact-backed behavior and is not clearly disclosed in the main skill workflow as an external publication step.
[SDI-2] unexpected: External posting is a scope expansion from local code-quality improvement and may include file paths, evidence, and bug or architecture details.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad triggers are understandable for a general code-quality skill, but they increase the chance of accidental activation given the skill also contains edit and publication paths.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The publication instructions do not require a user preview or explicit approval before sending qualifying findings to GitHub Discussions.
[SSD-4] unexpected: The instruction to resume after a harness stop signal is not appropriate for a skill and creates a control-boundary concern.
